textAnnotations.description:
GU ERIDERMIS
REDUCES PORE APPEARANCE
UnoU/INGREDIENTS: ETHYLHEXYL PALMITATE, ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE, PEG-20 GLYCERY TRISOSTEARATE,
SYNTHETIC WAX GLYCERYL BEHENATE/ECOSADIDATE CHARCOAL POWDER, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, BUTYROSPERMUM
PARKI BUTTER POLYGLYCERYL-2 ISOSTEARATE, PHENOXYETHANOL, FRAGRANCE, LAURYL DEG-
POLYDIMETHYLSILOXYETHYL DIMETHICONE CHLORPHENESIN BUTYLATED HYDROXYTOLUENE TOCOPHERYL
ACETATE WATER GLYCERIN ALLANTOIN EPIGALLOCATECHIN GALLATE SALICYLIC ACID, ORYZA SATIVA BRANO.
BRASSICA CAMPESTRIS SEED OIL, CERAMIDE NP. DIPROPYLENE GLYCOL, TOCOPHEROL HYDROGENATED
LECITHIN BAMBUSA VULGARIS LEAF EXTRACT, CAMELLIA JAPONICA SEED OIL CAMELA SINENSIS LEAF
EXTRACT SACCHAROMYCES/COPPER FERMENT, SACCHAROMYCES/RON FERMENT, SACCHAROMYCES/MAGNESIUM
FERMENT SACCHAROMYCES/SILICON FERMENT, SACCHAROMYCES/ZINE FERMENT GLYCERYL STEARATE, ORYZA-
LEUCONOSTOE/RADISH ROOT FERMENT FILTRATE ALPINA ZERUMBET LEAF ON CALOPHYLLUM INGPHYLLUM.
GATIVA GERM DI PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL VITIS VINIFERA SEED OIL CITRUSANDS SEED OIL
SEL OIL CAMELLIA SINENSIS SEER ON CERAMIDE AP CERAMIDE AS CERAMIDE NS CHOLESTEROL: CITRUS
"DEPRESSA SEED OMEJANTHUS ANNUUS SEED ON BUTYROSPERMUM PARK ON CONSAVE AN
Di MNANTHES ALBA SEED OIL, MACADAMIA TERNIFOLIA SEED OR BENDTHERA BIENES QUE
O ROSA CANINA FRUIT OIL SIMMONDS CHINENSIS SEED ON CERAMIDE-
LATISSIM
